verdict.rationale: The API covers the core UI workflow: converting local or URL-hosted files (plus FTP, SFTP and S3) via the jobs endpoint, querying supported target formats, downloading results and deleting files from Zamzar's servers. The evidence does not show parity for several UI features, including Box, Dropbox, Google Drive and OneDrive imports, the 'Email when done' option and the newly advertised compression. The SDK's 'all features of the API' refers to the API's own scope and does not claim parity with the UI. missing for 10: documented API equivalents for cloud-drive imports, email-on-completion and compression; an explicit parity statement or machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all returned 404).
